children: KALA BIO's net loss narrowed to $850K from $7.6M year over year, as operating expenses fell following the discontinuation of KPI-012 and the MSC-S platform; lower interest income and the absence of grant income partly offset the reduction.
² Reported as “Net loss and comprehensive loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share attributable to common stockholders—basic and diluted *”.
: The company processed proprietary datasets using its licensed platform to train and operate models for potential commercial applications; work remains in development.
: KALA became the exclusive U.S. distributor and reseller of an ophthalmology genetic testing and screening program, subject to a milestone by September 3, 2027.
: Costs fell to $5K from $6.1M, primarily due to discontinuation of KPI-012 and workforce reductions.

: The company said its cash and loan receivable would not fund operating expenses and service obligations into 4Q 2027, and reported substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
